## Hyvä-Specific Upgrade Concerns

- **Hyvä theme version**: must match Magento version — check `hyva-themes/magento2-default-theme` (1.5.2) compatibility against the target Magento release. Verify the Hyvä compatibility matrix before bumping Magento.
- **Hyvä checkout / luma-checkout version**: `hyva-themes/magento2-luma-checkout` (1.1.7) may lag behind the Magento release schedule — check compatibility matrix. (Note: active checkout is Mageplaza OSC, not Hyvä React checkout.)
- **Tailwind CSS v4**: Hyvä's Tailwind toolchain is CSS-first (`@theme`/`@source` in `tailwind-source.css`, NO `tailwind.config.js`). Newer Tailwind v4 features may require regenerating the theme's `styles.css` build. **Corrects older Hyvä docs that reference a `tailwind.config.js`.**
- **Alpine.js**: version compatibility with Hyvä's Alpine.js wrapper — verify after any Hyvä upgrade.
- **Magewire**: 1.13.3 — verify compatibility with target Magento + Hyvä.
- **Custom Hyvä modules**: any `Hyva_*` module and the Mollie Hyvä compat bundle (3.1.0) must be verified after upgrade.

> **Upgrade checklist (when first upgrade is planned):**
> 1. Check Hyvä compatibility matrix vs target Magento version.
> 2. Regenerate Tailwind v4 build (`tailwind-source.css` → `styles.css`); confirm no `tailwind.config.js` is introduced.
> 3. Full VNPAY payment regression (Pay redirect → Info return → IPN signature + idempotency).
> 4. End-to-end Mageplaza OSC checkout QC + payment test.
> 5. VN address dropdown cascade regression (country→state→city→sub-city).
> 6. Verify Mollie Hyvä compat bundle + Magewire against target versions.
> 7. Confirm production infra (Redis/Varnish/OpenSearch) still matches new version requirements.
